<infobox theme="group">
	<image source="imagefallback">
		<default>{{InfoboxGallery|image={{{image|}}}|caption1={{{option1|}}}|image2={{{image2|}}}|caption2={{{option2|}}}}}</default>
	</image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <navigation name="mobile-eras"><center>{{Top-mobile}}</center></navigation>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>General information</header>
        <data source="type"><label>Organization type</label></data>	
        <data source="founder"><label>Founder(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="leader"><label>Leader(s)</label></data>
        <data source="subgroup"><label>Sub-group(s)</label></data>	
        <data source="headquarters"><label>Headquarters</label></data>	
        <data source="locations"><label>Location(s)</label></data>	
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Historical information</header>
        <data source="formed"><label>Formed from</label></data>	
        <data source="founded"><label>Date founded</label></data>	
        <data source="fragmented"><label>Date fragmented</label></data>	
        <data source="reorganized"><label>Date reorganized</label></data>	
        <data source="dissolved"><label>Date dissolved</label></data>        
        <data source="restored"><label>Date restored</label></data>	
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Other information</header>
        <data source="affiliation"><label>Affiliation</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:Organization|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.

The following code flags infoboxes that do not have parameters defined.
-->{{#invoke:InfoboxParamCheck|main|image|name|type|founder|leader|subgroup|headquarters|locations|formed|founded|fragmented|reorganized|dissolved|restored|affiliation|optional=image2,option1,option2|ignore=name}}<noinclude>{{Top|fprot}}[[Category:Group infobox templates]]

==Usage instructions==
Copy and paste the following code into the top of the article, filling the appropriate fields. Omitted or blank fields will not be shown on the article page.

<pre><nowiki>{{Top|}}
{{Organization
|image=
|name=
|type=
|founder=
|leader=
|subgroup=
|headquarters=
|locations=
|formed=
|founded=
|fragmented=
|reorganized=
|dissolved=
|restored=
|affiliation=
}}</nowiki></pre></noinclude>
